note: ONE published rate, and it is real: 600,000 VND per hour for 1-on-1 tuition, as NET has billed it. This file deliberately does not carry a tier ladder, a discount matrix or an exchange-rate conversion, because none of those has been published by the coach and inventing them on a website is how a business starts lying to its own customers.

free.title: The 30-minute diagnostic
free.detail: Free, at your home if you are in the zone. A conversation, a reading of where you are, and one immediate win before you decide anything.

included: The full diagnostic conversation and a written reading of your level
A plan built around your week — the 45/15, not an evening class
All materials chosen for you, including the 10-5-5-3 breakdown of each hour
Daily accountability on the 45/15 ratio, tracked as a streak
The AI-PET spaced-repetition schedule (1 · 3 · 7 · 14 · 30 days) on your struggle points
Progress reviews: what improved, what did not, in numbers

guarantee.title: The 100% Confidence Guarantee
guarantee.body: We do not promise perfect grammar in 30 days. We promise that a student who follows the 45/15 protocol will completely lose the fear of opening their mouth to speak English.
guarantee.terms: Take the first month. If there is no massive, measurable surge in speaking velocity and confidence, the tuition is refunded in full. The student risks nothing.
guarantee.source: GOSPEL 444 · G444.011 — the doctrine NET teaches by. Quoted as written.

quoted.title: Blocks and prepayment
quoted.detail: Quoted by the coach. There is a published hourly rate; block pricing is a decision the coach makes with you, not a number this website invents.

quoted.title: Group and family rates
quoted.detail: Two learners or more are quoted on the diagnostic, in person. The calculator below shows the group reduction the coach has indicated, clearly marked as pending confirmation.

quoted.title: Corporate and school contracts
quoted.detail: Priced per engagement after a scoping call. Includes team hours, private sessions and reporting.

quoted.title: Travel outside the zone
quoted.detail: Lakeview City, District 2 and the surrounding districts are the home zone. Outside it, travel is agreed in the quote.
